methods.description: Interpret a nonzero remainder as one extra container when every item needs a place.
Count only complete groups/full-length pieces; report remaining length separately if requested.
Report the remainder with the correct units when asked for leftovers.
For minimum trips and complete groups, explain why the same division needs different interpretations.
Compare available capacity with required whole groups; decide whether enough containers/seats are supplied.
